narr: Thunderstorms trained over the eastern parts of San Patricio County during the afternoon on the 9th and over Aransas and eastern Calhoun Counties on the morning of the 10th. The storms produced very heavy rainfall with amounts between 3 to 5 inches. The heavy rainfall caused flooding in Aransas Pass, Rockport, and Port Lavaca.
ev: Rockport Police Department reported several streets flooded across the city with roads impassable for small cars.
Port Lavaca Police Department reported several roads flooded across the city along with Farm to Market Road 1090. Barricades were needed.
Law enforcement reported vehicles street flooding with vehicles stranded in Aransas Pass on West Nelson Avenue and Farm to Market Road 1069.
